answer: A payout is split and thus 58% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The lagoon schedule is applied in grove and ridge exposes each instalment. Anyone hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1162 identities would post 3632 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
